result.evidence: The primary models 3JH40, 4JH45, 4JH57, 4JH80, and 4JH110 are all marine diesel engines from Yanmar's JH-CR common rail series, referenced together and compatible with the VC30 control system. Variants of marine gears KM4A, KM35A, and others are clustered by model family due to oil specification and usage context. Saildrive SD60 variants are clustered as sub-versions of the same saildrive product. Vessel control systems VC10, VC20, and VC30 are distinct products with separate capabilities and are kept separate. ZF marine gears are referenced but distinct from Yanmar gears and clustered by model family. Instrument panels and fuel gauges are referenced but not clustered as primary or referenced products due to limited technical integration content.
